title: Quasinormal modes of massless scalar and electromagnetic perturbations for Euler-Heisenberg black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter
summary: We investigate the quasinormal modes of massless scalar and electromagnetic perturbations in charged Euler--Heisenberg black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter. The quasinormal frequencies are calculated using the asymptotic iteration method and the sixth-order WKB approximation, and the relative deviation between the two methods is quantitatively analyzed to verify the reliability of results.
